sources.snippet: MiniCPM-OCR Jev is an OCR correctness decision model for text, formulas, and tables. Given an image and its corresponding OCR result, it returns a quality score from 0 to 1 to help select reliable results and locate content that needs review.

sources.title: openbmb/MiniCPM-OCR-1.0 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: MiniCPM-OCR 1.0 (1.3B) is the first OCR-specific model in the MiniCPM-V/o family. It focuses on text-centric document understanding — text, tables, formulas, charts, seals, and structured information extraction — and balances quality against speed on real-world captures.

sources.snippet: On October 21, 2026, the model openbmb/MiniCPM-OCR-1.0 was published on HuggingFace with the image-text-to-text task. It is the first OCR-specific model in the MiniCPM-V/o family, focused on document understanding: text, tables, formulas, charts, stamps and structured information extraction.
